name: Stepper
description: Animated workflow steps with dotted upcoming connectors, solid completed connections, and glossy step controls.
summary: A controlled monochrome stepper with spring-scaled indicators, fading completion checks, and dotted-to-solid connector crossfades. Container queries stack steps vertically in narrow containers and horizontally in larger ones. The parent owns progression, validation, and content. Completed steps can be revisited when onStepChange is provided.
highlights: Controlled progression and optional navigation to completed steps
Transform and opacity animations with dotted-to-solid connectors and Candy-style highlights and shadows
Light and dark themes with reduced-motion support

physics.description: Motion springs step indicators and fades completion checks and solid completed lines over dotted upcoming connectors.

accessibility.aria: Current item exposes aria-current=step. Labels include completed, current, or upcoming status. Future step buttons are disabled.
accessibility.reducedMotion: Transitions use zero duration, indicators do not scale or translate, and completion checks appear immediately.

keyboard.description: Activate the current or a completed step.
Move focus between enabled steps without changing the current step.
Focus the first or last enabled step.

bestPractices: Supply unique stable ids and descriptive step titles.
Keep form validation and step content in the parent.
Pass steps.length only once the workflow completes.
Announce content changes and manage form focus in the parent.
Use orientation=auto for small containers and long labels.

props.name: steps
props.type: { id: string; title: string; description?: string }[]
props.description: Ordered steps with stable unique ids.

props.name: currentStep
props.description: Zero-based current step. Set to steps.length to mark every step complete. Finite values are truncated and clamped; non-finite values use 0.

props.name: onStepChange
props.description: Enables buttons for the current and completed steps. Future steps remain disabled.

props.name: ariaLabel
props.description: Accessible label for the navigation landmark.

props.name: orientation
props.description: Auto stacks vertically in narrow containers and horizontally from 448px. Horizontal and vertical force the selected layout.

props.name: showDescriptions
props.description: Show each step’s optional supporting description.

props.name: animated
props.description: Enable Motion transitions. Reduced-motion preferences always take precedence.

props.name: ref
props.description: Ref forwarded to the navigation element for DOM access and measurement.
